answer: The anchor counter is kept in oasis and glacier makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 42 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
